observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same setup: a Nikon D3300 DSLR camera body with a lens, placed on its original box.
The box clearly states 'D3300 18-55 VR II Kit' and 'AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II'.
The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D3300' visible on the top and front, respectively.
The lens has 'Nikon DX AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II' printed on the barrel.
The background shows other camera accessories, including a flash and another box labeled 'L12d'.
The box also mentions 'VR' and 'BLACK' branding.
No visible damage to the camera or lens in the photos.
The seller claims '24.2 MP CMOS DX-format sensor', '5 frames per second continuous shooting', '11 AF points with 3D...', and 'Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens'.
